snippet.description:
Starting UPSC preparation can be confusing. What should you study first? How much should you study? When should you start answer writing?
AIR 100 Sattwik Satyakam Devata breaks down the system he believes beginners need to build from Day 1. From understanding the syllabus and PYQs to choosing limited sources, integrating Current Affairs, balancing Prelims with Mains, practising CSAT and learning from tests, this session covers what actually matters.
If you’re starting UPSC preparation, this is a good place to begin.


Enrollment Open in GS Foundation Program for UPSC CSE 2028: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-gs-foundation-course/
